section_summary.extract_value: This section defines gratitude, primarily adhering to McCullough et al.'s (2002) definition as an affective trait, and also referencing Wood, Froh, and Geraghty's (2010) broader conceptualization. It discusses gratitude's role as a moral barometer, a reinforcement for reciprocal altruism, and its connection to enhanced well-being, citing various research findings on its psychological benefits.
